exercises.title: Define continuity
exercises.objective: Use inverse images of every open set.

exercises.title: Check identity and finite examples
exercises.objective: Distinguish inverse-image preservation from direct-image openness.
success: discrete to indiscrete identity is continuous

exercises.title: Distinguish continuous and open maps
exercises.objective: Use constant false from discrete Bool to Sierpiński space.
success: continuous not open map is constant false

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} (τ : LeanCraftGame.Topology.MyTopology α) : T8.MyContinuous τ τ id := by intro s hs; exact hs
checks.message: Identity must be continuous: apply your definition to an arbitrary open set.

checks.lean:
example {α β : Type*} (τs : LeanCraftGame.Topology.MyTopology α) (τt : LeanCraftGame.Topology.MyTopology β) (b : β) : T8.MyContinuous τs τt (fun _ => b) := by
  intro s hs
  by_cases hb : b ∈ s
  · rw [Set.preimage_const_of_mem hb]
    exact τs.isOpen_univ
  · rw [Set.preimage_const_of_notMem hb]
    exact τs.isOpen_empty
checks.message: Every constant map must be continuous; split on whether the constant belongs to the open set and use `univ` or `∅`.

checks.lean:
example : ¬ T8.MyContinuous (LeanCraftGame.Topology.indiscrete Bool) (LeanCraftGame.Topology.discrete Bool) id := by
  intro h
  have ho := h {true} (by trivial)
  have hn : ¬ (LeanCraftGame.Topology.indiscrete Bool).IsOpen {true} := by
    simp [LeanCraftGame.Topology.indiscrete, Set.ext_iff]
  exact hn (by simpa using ho)
checks.message: The identity is not continuous from indiscrete to discrete: apply your definition to the codomain's singleton `{true}`.

checks.lean:
example : T8.MyContinuous (LeanCraftGame.Topology.discrete Bool) LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski T8.continuousNotOpenMap := by
  intro s hs
  by_cases hb : T8.continuousNotOpenMap false ∈ s
  · have h : T8.continuousNotOpenMap ⁻¹' s = Set.univ := Set.preimage_const_of_mem hb
    rw [h]
    trivial
  · have h : T8.continuousNotOpenMap ⁻¹' s = ∅ := Set.preimage_const_of_notMem hb
    rw [h]
    trivial
checks.message: Every map from a discrete space is continuous, including this constant false map.

checks.lean:
example : ¬ T8.MyOpenMap (LeanCraftGame.Topology.discrete Bool) LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski T8.continuousNotOpenMap := by
  intro h
  have hi := h {true} trivial
  have him : T8.continuousNotOpenMap '' {true} = {false} := by
    ext b
    simp [T8.continuousNotOpenMap]
  rw [him] at hi
  simp [LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski, LeanCraftGame.Topology.particularPoint] at hi
checks.message: This map is not open: the open singleton `{true}` has image `{false}`, which is not open in Sierpiński space.

steps: Given an open `s` in the codomain, which set in the domain must be open?
hints.hint: Use `∀ s, τt.IsOpen s → τs.IsOpen (f ⁻¹' s)`.
Use direct images: `∀ s, τs.IsOpen s → τt.IsOpen (f '' s)`. The concrete map is `fun _ => false`.
